This document outlines the equipment inspection of turbine
oil pump, which must be performed every
six months as indicated by M6 in above title block.

Lubrication oil pump is used for lubricate bearing 1-2-3 coupling 
1-2, accessory gears and reduction gears.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Sameh Sobhi El-Sayed, tested by
 eng. Abed Esmail, revised by 
eng. Abouda Elbana Quality control MDEPC, 
accepted by general manager eng. Yosry Abd El-Maksuod and approved by
eng. Farok Awad head sector of Talkha
Power Station.

This document accepted by 
Eng. Samir Abdel Gilil 
; MDEPC
inspection and quality control general
director, MPIS coordinator, and certified inspection by head sector
Eng. Mohamed Nageeb .

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance
staff should carry the suitable safety category.

safety and healthy, shoes and gloves pairs...etc.
